theater_tak_quest_02_01_03: Yes, I'm on my way back to our home.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_06: So you weren't exploring the Dungeon today.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_08:
Ha ha ha, it's nothing special.
Those marks on your breastplate...
They're from sparring with a person, right?
theater_tak_quest_02_01_09:
Your opponent used a greatsword, I'd say...
Were you training with Welf Crozzo?
theater_tak_quest_02_01_11:
And those small nicks near your vitals...
You couldn't fully deflect heavy blows. Not
dodging—you were practicing parries, then.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_13:
Ha ha, it's no big deal.
Once you're used to it, you'll be able
to read that much too.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_14:
No, really... I think I understand a little
why Ms. Mikoto and the others
respect you so much.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_15:
Don't flatter me too much. They may call
me a god of martial arts, but right now I'm
just one more omniscient, powerless god.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_18:
About deflecting attacks, like you said...
Is there any kind of trick to it...?
theater_tak_quest_02_01_19:
A trick, huh... In the end, I think
the fastest way is repetition—training
until it hurts, again and again.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_21:
Hey, what you're doing isn't wrong.
You'll master it before long, I'm sure.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_27:
From the look of you, you're pushing too hard.
If you don't recover from your fatigue,
your body won't get any stronger.
theater_tak_quest_02_01_28:
Above all, it affects the quality of the next
day's training. If you like, I'll teach you
the secret art of resting your body.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_01:
U-um...?
Why did we come to our home?
theater_tak_quest_02_02_02:
Mikoto told me. Apparently you've got
a splendid cypress bath here.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_03:
The bath...? You mean the Far East-style one
Ms. Mikoto had the Goibniu Familia
build for her...?
theater_tak_quest_02_02_04:
Right. It's the perfect place to practice
resting your body and recharging
for tomorrow.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_06:
First, you soak in the hot water and warm
yourself up slowly. That improves circulation,
loosens stiffness, and drains the fatigue.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_07:
On top of that, the scent of cypress
has a calming effect.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_08:
A bath can do all that...!
And the cypress actually means something...!
theater_tak_quest_02_02_09:
And if you get a massage in the water,
you'll recover even faster.
While we're at it, I'll show you firsthand!
theater_tak_quest_02_02_10:
You warm up in water that's a little on the hot
side, and work the muscles loose like this.
How's that? Feels good, right?
theater_tak_quest_02_02_11:
Y-yeeesss...
I'm all toasty... and floaty...
theater_tak_quest_02_02_12:
Ha ha ha, pretty nice, isn't it?
Soon your body will loosen up...
or, uh, you're already pretty limp...?
theater_tak_quest_02_02_13:
M-my head's... all foggy...
Everything's going... white...
*blub blub blub*...
theater_tak_quest_02_02_15:
Takeee!!
What do you think you're doing to my Bell?!
theater_tak_quest_02_02_16:
I'm truly sorry...!
I can't believe I let him get
lightheaded from the heat...!
theater_tak_quest_02_02_17:
I-I'm the one who asked...
Lord Takemikazuchi was only being kind...
theater_tak_quest_02_02_18:
No, it's my fault for keeping someone who's
not used to baths in so long. I should have
remembered this isn't the Far East.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_19:
Well... luckily it wasn't serious, so fine...
But be careful next time, okay?
theater_tak_quest_02_02_20:
Yes, of course.
Sorry about that, Bell.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_21:
No... You carried me here, and now
you're even fanning me...
I'm the one who should apologize...
theater_tak_quest_02_02_22:
None of that modesty.
Back at the shrine, I used to look after
the kids like this all the time.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_23:
That's right, Bell!
You just keep resting. See? You're still warm.
theater_tak_quest_02_02_24:
Whoa?! Goddess, you're close!
Too close!
theater_tak_quest_02_02_25:
Come on, Bell, stay still.
Thrashing around will only heat you up more.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_01:
Looks like you've calmed down a lot.
Your color's better too.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_02:
Yes, thank you, Lord Takemikazuchi.
I'm all right now.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_03:
Heh... This really takes me back.
Ouka, Mikoto, Chigusa—none of them
need this kind of looking after anymore.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_05:
Ha, I've watched them since they were kids.
When they were little, they got dizzy
in the bath all the time.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_06:
Well... back then too, it was because
I got carried away and kept them
in the water too long...
theater_tak_quest_02_03_07: So you haven't learned a thing...
theater_tak_quest_02_03_08: Ha ha ha, I can't argue with that.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_09:
Still... with time they grew up, and that
stopped happening. Maybe that's why
I let my guard down.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_11:
Hm? What's wrong, you two?
Your faces are red. Didn't I fan you enough?
theater_tak_quest_02_03_13:
Y-y-y-you mean everyone... even Ms. Mikoto
and Ms. Chigusa... took baths with you
until that recently...?!
theater_tak_quest_02_03_14:
Of course. Those two are like daughters to me.
Watching them grow up is a patron god's
greatest joy...
theater_tak_quest_02_03_18: Oh, Mikoto. We were just talking about you...
theater_tak_quest_02_03_19:
What on earth are you saying?!
You'll give our hosts the wrong idea...!
theater_tak_quest_02_03_20:
What? It's the truth, isn't it?
Not long ago I washed your back,
and Chigusa's too.
theater_tak_quest_02_03_22:
M-Mikoto! Is that the kind of
scandalous relationship you all have?!
theater_tak_quest_02_03_23:
N-n-n-no, it is not!
We are not so debauched...!
theater_tak_quest_02_03_24:
The last time I bathed with
Lord Takemikazuchi was nearly ten years ago!
theater_tak_quest_02_03_26:
Well, that's "not long ago."
I wasn't wrong, was I?
theater_tak_quest_02_03_28:
Ahh... Right. For a god, ten years ago
really is "not long ago"...
theater_tak_quest_02_03_29:
Oh, I know. Since we're here,
I'll wash your back too, Mikoto—
theater_her_quest_01_01_01:
The whole familia summoned to
The Benevolent Mistress...
What kind of trouble is it this time...?
theater_her_quest_01_01_02:
I sure don't want to pick a fight with that place.
It's the scariest tavern in Orario—
literally.
theater_her_quest_01_01_03:
Lord Hermes should know that full well...
Either way, I have a bad feeling about this.
theater_her_quest_01_01_05:
Come on, sit wherever you like.
And enjoy... a night of the finest dreams!
theater_her_quest_01_01_06: L-Lord Hermes... What is all this...?
theater_her_quest_01_01_07:
Heh... Isn't it obvious?
Tonight is an appreciation party!
A grand feast to wash away your fatigue!
theater_her_quest_01_01_09:
Does he even know whose fault it is
we're so worn out...?
theater_her_quest_01_01_10:
Ha ha ha! Tonight, rank doesn't matter!
I'll gladly hear all your gripes!
theater_her_quest_01_01_11:
Tonight this tavern is the Traveler God's Cradle!
Whatever fatigue or complaints you've got,
I'll take them all!
theater_her_quest_01_01_12: Don't go renaming our shop, nya!
theater_her_quest_01_01_13:
That's right, nya! If Mama Mia
heard that, she'd—
theater_her_quest_01_01_14:
That's enough.
Let's not spoil a day like this, kittens.
theater_her_quest_01_01_15:
Now, everyone, enjoy yourselves!
Just for today, I'll be your host
and wait on you hand and foot!
theater_her_quest_01_01_17: I brought you a drink, Andromeda.
theater_her_quest_01_01_19:
...Why not stop overthinking it
and just enjoy yourself?
theater_her_quest_01_01_21:
Lord Hermes told me he wanted to give you all
a chance to unwind, since you work
so hard for him every day.
theater_her_quest_01_01_22:
He is that sort of god, but if he means it,
he would hardly want you
to not enjoy yourselves.
theater_her_quest_01_01_23:
...Because he's that sort of god, I can never
tell if he means it. Sometimes there's
a catch.
theater_her_quest_01_01_24:
...Like a warm-up before dumping
some impossible job on us.
theater_her_quest_01_01_25:
Then all the more reason to enjoy it.
Think of it as payment in advance.
theater_her_quest_01_02_01:
Here—the finest steak, hand-picked by yours truly!
A feast of wine and meat!
Eat your fill!
theater_her_quest_01_02_02:
Whoa! Amazing!
Lord Hermes, this is super tasty...!
theater_her_quest_01_02_03:
Whoops, your glass is empty.
Come on, drink up, drink up!
theater_her_quest_01_02_04:
Oi! Keep it down!
You don't own this place!
theater_her_quest_01_02_06:
Ah, sorry about the noise.
My children are still young.
theater_her_quest_01_02_07:
They don't understand the tastes and finer
points of a grown man like you. That's my
failing as a teacher. Please accept my apology.
theater_her_quest_01_02_09:
Spoken like a true grown man.
How about it—let me buy you a drink?
theater_her_quest_01_02_10:
Well, if you put it that way...
Don't mind if I do.
theater_her_quest_01_02_12:
When it comes to talking, he's one of
the smoothest gods there is...
theater_her_quest_01_02_13:
But... what is he really up to...?
Volunteering even for chores like that...
theater_her_quest_01_02_14:
Perhaps he simply doesn't want
the hassle to reach all of you?
theater_her_quest_01_02_15:
I hope that's all it is...
I just can't help suspecting a catch...
theater_her_quest_01_02_17:
If you, who work hardest of all, act like this,
won't your members have a hard time
enjoying themselves too?
theater_her_quest_01_02_19:
Exactly, Asfi!
All I want is for you to have fun!
theater_her_quest_01_02_21:
Now, next up is tonight's main event!
Here, Asfi, take this.
theater_her_quest_01_02_22: A sheet of paper with numbers...?
theater_her_quest_01_02_23:
It's what they call a bingo tournament!
You don't see it much in the mortal world.
theater_her_quest_01_02_25:
Basically, a raffle with a little twist.
Look, it's starting!
theater_her_quest_01_02_26:
Twenty, nya! If you've got a 20,
punch a hole in it, nya!
theater_her_quest_01_02_28:
Ooh, off to a good start!
Get a full line and you win big. Good luck!
theater_her_quest_01_02_30:
...Caution is one of your virtues, but
sometimes it might be nice to simply
trust in things.
theater_her_quest_01_03_01:
A stuffed animal this big...
What am I supposed to do with it...?
theater_her_quest_01_03_02: You sure made a fuss when you won, nya!
theater_her_quest_01_03_03:
Yeah, nya!
You were shouting "Bingo!" all excited, nya!
theater_her_quest_01_03_04:
That was... I got carried away...
I was told those were the rules...
theater_her_quest_01_03_05:
Here, Asfi—
how about some dessert to close the night?
theater_her_quest_01_03_06: A special treat I prepared just for you.
theater_her_quest_01_03_08:
You said you wanted to try it once, remember?
It's made with a fruit handed down
in the elven forests since ancient times...
theater_her_quest_01_03_09:
That was... before I even came to Orario.
I can't believe you remember
something from so long ago...
theater_her_quest_01_03_10:
I'm the type who never forgets
a lady's words. Especially when they
come from a precious child of mine.
theater_her_quest_01_03_11:
...Saying such sappy things again
without an ounce of shame...
theater_her_quest_01_03_12:
Ha ha ha, well, that's just me.
Enjoy every last bite.
theater_her_quest_01_03_13:
Come on, everyone, keep drinking
all the way to the end!
I love you guys!
theater_her_quest_01_03_16:
Yes. As captain, I thought I'd
clean up after us...
theater_her_quest_01_03_17:
You really are dutiful...
But if it's the cleanup, we'll take care of—
theater_her_quest_01_03_18:
What's this? We're closing up.
If you've had your fill, get on home.
theater_her_quest_01_03_19:
No, I thought tonight's bill might
still be unpaid. Lord Hermes left early,
after all...
theater_her_quest_01_03_20:
Besides, Lord Hermes shouldn't have
enough cash on hand to go
that wild here...
theater_her_quest_01_03_21: We don't do tabs or discounts.
theater_her_quest_01_03_23: What she means is, we've already been paid.
theater_her_quest_01_03_25:
Sheesh, didn't anyone tell you?
That god brought us a mountain
of ingredients.
theater_her_quest_01_03_26:
And rare ones from all over the world,
the kind you can hardly get your hands on.
theater_her_quest_01_03_28:
Said he had no money, so he wanted you lot
fed with those. And he'd work as a waiter
today to make up the difference.
theater_her_quest_01_03_29:
Far from falling short... there was
enough to keep us stocked
for about a week.
theater_her_quest_01_03_30:
That's how it is.
So it's nothing for you to worry about.
theater_her_quest_01_03_32:
And... he said one more thing. Since you
all work so hard for him, he wanted
the members—especially the captain—to have fun.
theater_her_quest_01_03_34:
Got it? Then go home. If anything's still
owed, I'll be sending the bill to that god,
not you.
theater_her_quest_01_03_36:
Thank you for the meal...
And... thank you.
theater_her_quest_02_01_02:
That's right, Lili! Basically, I want you
to take a prototype backpack into real combat
and tell me what you think!
theater_her_quest_02_01_03:
You were looking for a new backpack anyway,
right? Then why not give me a hand?
theater_her_quest_02_01_05:
Hey now, give me a break.
I'm the god of travel and commerce, you know?
theater_her_quest_02_01_06:
Safety and blessings for adventurers on the
harsh journey that is the Dungeon! That's why
I want to make and sell an easy-to-use backpack!
theater_her_quest_02_01_07:
It's the part about targeting supporters
instead of adventurers that bugs me.
theater_her_quest_02_01_08:
The market for adventurers is saturated, right?
Supporters, though—that's a blue ocean!
A frontier!
theater_her_quest_02_01_09:
Of course the god of commerce
would set his sights on it!
It's as obvious as obvious gets!
theater_her_quest_02_01_10:
...Isn't that less "god of commerce" and more
"greedy merchant"?
theater_her_quest_02_01_11:
Ha ha ha! Harsh, Lili.
But this isn't a bad deal for you either.
theater_her_quest_02_01_13:
I'm making the finest backpack there is!
If you test it for me and end up liking it...
theater_her_quest_02_01_14:
I'll sell you that prototype
at a bargain price!
theater_her_quest_02_01_16:
Asking for freebies in business is tacky.
Besides, it's only if you like it.
You're free not to buy it.
theater_her_quest_02_01_17:
Well... if that's how it is...
But why Lili?
theater_her_quest_02_01_19:
I hate to say it, but Lili is only Level 1.
If you want a prototype tested,
a stronger familia would...
theater_her_quest_02_01_20:
Call it an early investment.
I think very highly of Bell and all of you.
theater_her_quest_02_01_21:
Highly enough that, before long,
you might just take Orario by storm.
theater_her_quest_02_01_22: Well... maybe Mr. Bell will, but...
theater_her_quest_02_01_23:
Too much modesty isn't a virtue.
I don't think Bell would be where he is
without you.
theater_her_quest_02_01_24:
And an item used by people like you...
I'm sure it'll sell like crazy someday!
theater_her_quest_02_01_25:
Lili can't shake how fishy this is...
but she'll at least try it out.
theater_her_quest_02_01_26:
Yeah, I guarantee the quality.
Give it a go and tell me what you
honestly think.
theater_her_quest_02_02_01: Much as it pains Lili to say this...
theater_her_quest_02_02_02:
This backpack was ridiculously easy to use...
The capacity and weight are perfect.
theater_her_quest_02_02_03:
Best of all, it's tough enough to take a few
monster hits without a scratch... It's leagues
above anything Lili has used.
theater_her_quest_02_02_04:
Oh, is that so!
Well, well, Lili's seal of approval
is reassuring!
theater_her_quest_02_02_06:
Ah, you'd like to buy it as is?
No problem at all. I'll even throw in a bonus.
theater_her_quest_02_02_07: By the way, the price is... 24,900 valis.
theater_her_quest_02_02_08:
WHAT?! What kind of rip-off price is that?!
It's a backpack!
theater_her_quest_02_02_09:
That's over ten times a normal one!
Even Rivira would be shocked
by that price!
theater_her_quest_02_02_10:
You know better than anyone that its
performance is top-notch, Lili. Materials,
methods, artisans—no corners cut.
theater_her_quest_02_02_11:
Even so, nearly 30,000 valis is too much!
That doesn't look like a backpack price
anymore!
theater_her_quest_02_02_12:
Lili...
I believe supporters are a party's lifeline.
theater_her_quest_02_02_13:
Y-yes...?
What's this, all of a sudden?
theater_her_quest_02_02_14:
Just what it sounds like. The load you carry
is a direct measure of how long
your party can survive.
theater_her_quest_02_02_15:
The more supplies you have, the longer you live.
Run short, and only death awaits—
am I wrong?
theater_her_quest_02_02_16: Lili won't deny there's some truth to that...
theater_her_quest_02_02_17:
Then of course you want performance from the
backpack that protects those supplies! As I see it,
the age of high-performance backpacks is here!
theater_her_quest_02_02_18: This one backpack could save lives!
theater_her_quest_02_02_19:
And I'd say it's exactly the kind of gear
a fast-rising party like yours needs,
wouldn't you?
theater_her_quest_02_02_21:
So, what'll it be? Even at 24,900 valis,
with your monitor fee taken off,
I'm giving you a real discount here.
theater_her_quest_02_02_22:
Oh, fine! Lili gets it!
She'll buy it! She'll gladly buy it!
theater_her_quest_02_02_23:
Lili can't put a price on...
the party's safety, after all.
theater_her_quest_02_02_24:
Okay. Good call.
You're every bit the supporter I took you for.
theater_her_quest_02_02_25:
Honestly... what a smooth talker,
or whatever you call it...
theater_her_quest_02_02_26:
Ha, I'm Hermes, remember?
A deal like that is nothing.
theater_her_quest_02_02_27:
Now for the finishing touches.
One more push and we can
mass-produce the backpack.
theater_her_quest_02_02_28: So you really do plan to mass-produce it...
theater_her_quest_02_02_29:
Of course... Never let a future repeat
customer like Lili come out behind.
That's the iron rule of business.
theater_her_quest_02_03_03:
Hey, Li'l E.
...Wait, huh?! What's in that backpack...?!
theater_her_quest_02_03_04:
Yes, magic items...
And ones made by Perseus herself...
theater_her_quest_02_03_05:
Lili was only supposed to be
buying a backpack...
theater_her_quest_02_03_06:
Th-that's a huge amount, isn't it...?
Wasn't it expensive...?
theater_her_quest_02_03_10: We're taking a huge loss on this...
theater_her_quest_02_03_11:
The more we make, the more we lose...
It's absurd.
theater_her_quest_02_03_12:
Don't worry, there won't be many of them.
Adventurers who'd pay dozens of times
the going rate for a backpack, I mean.
theater_her_quest_02_03_13:
Besides, when it goes on sale for real,
I plan to double the price. We won't
end up in the red.
theater_her_quest_02_03_15: Think of this as a gift from me.
theater_her_quest_02_03_16:
For the foolish, capable adventurer
who'll spend a fortune without hesitation
to keep her friends safe.
theater_her_quest_02_03_17:
Even so, isn't it overboard...?
Who do you think makes all
those magic items...?
theater_her_quest_02_03_18:
I'm grateful, Asfi.
Without you, this backpack
never would've been finished.
theater_her_quest_02_03_19:
Honestly... why do I always end up
with the grunt work...?
theater_her_quest_02_03_20:
Don't you want promising adventurers
like Bell and Lili to survive too, Asfi?
theater_her_quest_02_03_21:
The quality's guaranteed. Add Perseus's magic
items, and any adventurer who knows the value of
life will be a repeat customer, no doubt about it.
theater_her_quest_02_03_23:
I just felt like offering a little support.
As a god who governs and blesses
all journeys—
theater_her_quest_02_03_24:
—to those foolish yet dazzling travelers
who head into the jaws of death
and still fight to come back alive.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_01:
—You want me to take Lena and Samira
and raid a brothel?
theater_ish_quest_01_01_02:
Nothing so grand. You just surround the
brothel in question and catch anyone
who tries to run.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_04:
What's that supposed to mean...? And why a

familia's turf, isn't it?
theater_ish_quest_01_01_07:
I thought I'd show the people of the
Pleasure Quarter what becomes of fools
who harbor petty ambitions...
theater_ish_quest_01_01_09:
Heh. They spat on me, the one who rules
Orario's nights, whom even gods and the Guild
fear. They deserve what's coming, don't they?
theater_ish_quest_01_01_10:
Sending in the Berbera too?
That's less "what's coming"
and more overkill, if you ask me...
theater_ish_quest_01_01_11:
That's why it's amusement.
The more you spend on amusement,
the flashier—the more splendid—it gets.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_13:
You should enjoy yourselves too.
I've prepared a little trick for the occasion.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_14:
Aisha, why is Lady Ishtar doing this herself...?
What did those brothel people even do?
theater_ish_quest_01_01_15:
As far as I know, skimming off the take,
pocketing the tribute...
that kind of thing.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_17:
Their money's looked fishy lately, so I was

so I let it slide.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_18:
That's not why Lady Ishtar is moving.
Most likely... something about Freya
got under her skin...
theater_ish_quest_01_01_20:
Yeah. They're in for some cruel divine
punishment, with a side of taking it out
on them.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_21:
Honestly... why'd those brothel folks have to
step on the tiger's tail at the worst
possible time...?
theater_ish_quest_01_01_22:
Hm? You're going already?
It's not the time Lady Ishtar told us yet...
theater_ish_quest_01_01_23:
There are some girls I know at that brothel.
Even if I can't save them, I can at least...
see how it ends.
theater_ish_quest_01_01_24:
Call it sympathy between fools
who defied a patron god
they never should have crossed.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_01:
The place is surrounded.
So... what now?
theater_ish_quest_01_02_03: ...Oh yes, Aisha. You're coming with me.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_04: I don't get a say... do I?
theater_ish_quest_01_02_05:
Heh...
And I've got a drink worthy of tonight's feast.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_06:
Look—Soma.
Perfect for sipping while you enjoy the show.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_07:
I'll pass... Being charmed by you
is more than enough for me, Lady Ishtar.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_12: Lady Ishtar... what did you do...?
theater_ish_quest_01_02_14:
Wha—?! Now *that's* overkill!
The only bouncers here are
low-level adventurers...!
theater_ish_quest_01_02_16:
I only ordered Phryne to dispose
of the adventurers.
The main course is just getting started.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_19:
............
...Ruler of the night...
queen of the Pleasure Quarter...
theater_ish_quest_01_02_20:
Yes. This quarter is my castle.
Anyone who draws a bow against me here—
even an ant—will be utterly crushed.
theater_ish_quest_01_02_21:
I'll grow my power with pleasure and fear...
until I drag that sow of a beauty goddess
off her throne in the white Tower of Babel...!
theater_ish_quest_01_02_23:
...About time.
Let's go. You enjoy it too.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_02:
I don't know... It's just...
I love Lady Ishtar...
theater_ish_quest_01_03_06:
Oh, I just let a few drops of poison
fall into this brothel.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_09:
I "charmed" a few of the girls and
commanded them: "Kill each other."
theater_ish_quest_01_03_11:
The poison spreads as distrust and suspicion...
and the fools dance and dance...
until their lives run out.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_14: Well? Isn't it a marvelous dance?
theater_ish_quest_01_03_19:
Gah...?!
Why you... how dare you...!!
theater_ish_quest_01_03_24:
This is an "internal dispute."
Fools fighting over a pittance.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_26:
Something like that. But who's playing the
music for this dance... anyone in the
Pleasure Quarter can tell at a glance.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_28:
Heh heh... Then will you resist me again,
like you once did?
Resist my "charm"...?
theater_ish_quest_01_03_30:
Good. Don't do anything pointless.
You belong to me,
just like this quarter does.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_32:
...Looks like the show is over.
That was rather fun.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_34:
Dismiss the Berbera.
And... be sure to leave no evidence.
theater_ish_quest_01_03_37:
...You have my sympathy.
You were unlucky... you all, and me too...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_02:
That masala fruit soup...
blow on it and feed it to me...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_03:
Heh. Together even in her dreams.
Orion is well loved.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_04: Hestia, I'm stepping out for a bit.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_05: Mmm... I can't eat another bite...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_06:
—Huh? Lady Artemis?
What are you doing up so early?
theater_arte_quest_01_01_07:
We're short on food because I gave ours
to that mother and child, aren't we?
theater_arte_quest_01_01_08:
So I thought I'd at least gather something
everyone can eat while there's time.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_09:
What about you?
We still have time before we set out.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_10:
Well...
actually, I was going to look for food too...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_11: ...I see. So we had the same idea.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_12:
Um, Lady Artemis,
if it's all right, maybe we could go together...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_13:
This is my responsibility.
It's only right that I go alone.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_14:
Well... that scorpion-like monster
might show up again.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_15:
And more than anything... I can't let
a goddess go off all by herself...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_16:
Heh... I won't fall behind against
wild beasts or surface monsters.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_17: Um... that's not what I meant...
theater_arte_quest_01_01_19:
Please don't push yourself too hard,
Lady Artemis.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_22:
—Heh. Heh heh... Ah ha ha!
I see. Of course.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_24:
Because I'm a goddess... a woman.
That's why you worry about me.
theater_arte_quest_01_01_26:
I know you hold no contempt for women.
It's simply something you believe in,
isn't it?
theater_arte_quest_01_01_27:
Then... I accept your offer.
Will you come with me, Orion?
theater_arte_quest_01_02_03:
One shot... Even if it's a monster
from outside the city...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_11:
...I-I'm sorry.
I'm supposed to be the one protecting you...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_12:
Don't worry about it. Just as you try
to protect me, I'm glad I could
protect you.
theater_arte_quest_01_02_14:
More importantly... that wound
around your thigh.
theater_arte_quest_01_02_15:
Oh, I'm fine. I just snagged it on something
and scraped it. It's not worth
using a potion on...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_18:
Leave a wound untended and you risk tetanus...
or worse, it can turn to necrosis.
Better safe than sorry.
theater_arte_quest_01_02_19:
W-well... how do I put this... It's kind of
high up on my thigh... in a really awkward
spot... so, um...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_20:
I'm used to hunting in the forest.
I've treated wounds like this
countless times...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_22:
Just show me the wound, quickly.
If it gets dirty, it's far more likely
to get worse.
theater_arte_quest_01_02_23:
B-but... if I show you the wound,
my battle clothes would have to...
theater_arte_quest_01_02_24:
Yes, take them off.
If your clothes are dirty, that would
make things even worse—
theater_arte_quest_01_02_25:
It's healed! Like, all of a sudden!
I-I'm gonna go see if there's any game
over theeeeere!!
theater_arte_quest_01_02_26:
Orion!
If you move, the wound will—!
theater_arte_quest_01_02_28:
Orion—don't think you can escape me
in the forest...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_02:
I said no, Lady Artemis!!
Please let go of meee!!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_03:
Stop squirming. What if you aggravate
the wound? Come on, just relax...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_05:
Nnn... what's all this...
So noisy first thing in the morning...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_06:
This medicine works very well.
But... why is your face so red?
Don't tell me it's infected and feverish...!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_08:
—Wh-wh-wh-what are you doing?!
The two of you... like that...!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_09:
Ah, Hestia. Orion's been moving around
so vigorously that I'm having trouble
getting it done.
theater_arte_quest_01_03_10:
V-v-v-VIGOROUSLY?!
Bell! Wh-wh-what in the world are you...?!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_11:
Th-that's not it!
Lady Artemis is forcing my pants off!!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_13:
A-Artemis?! Aren't you a virgin goddess?!
And Bell, you're getting vigorous and
forceful with a virgin goddess?!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_14:
Waaaaaaah!
What on earth is going ooon?!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_15:
—I see. I get what happened now.
Well, Artemis does seem a little...
different from how she used to be...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_16: I was only trying to treat Orion...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_18:
Well... I'm relieved nothing indecent
was going on. Not that I suspected
either of you...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_19: Mr. Bell! Lili brought a potion!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_20:
Now, off with them!
Lili will rub the potion on—!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_21: What do you think you're doing, supporter?!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_22:
Stay out of this, Lady Hestia! Lady Artemis
told Lili about this juicy—er, important duty!
It belongs to Lili, the supporter...!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_23:
You almost said "juicy," didn't you?!
Get away from Belllll!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_26:
...Honestly, you can't let your guard
down for a second.
theater_arte_quest_01_03_31:
Orion included, you've gathered
some truly wonderful children
around you, Hestia.
theater_arte_quest_01_03_32:
...Well, I won't deny it.
Bell, of course, and the smith,
and the supporter...
theater_arte_quest_01_03_33:
Wait, ugh! Don't make me say
embarrassing stuff like that!
You're throwing me off!
theater_arte_quest_01_03_34: Truly... the mortal world is wonderful.
theater_arte_quest_01_03_35:
Huh?
What's that all of a sudden?
theater_arte_quest_01_03_36:
Heh... It just occurred to me,
watching all of you.
theater_traning09_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the warning signs
enemies show before combo attacks.
theater_traning09_dialogue02_0010: The Orc Lord is preparing to attack.
theater_traning09_dialogue02_0020:
Powerful enemies may show several
warning signs in a row.
theater_traning09_dialogue03_0010:
The Orc Lord attacks in the order
its warning signs appeared.
theater_traning09_dialogue04_0010:
Warning signs are normally red,
but turn yellow for combo attacks.
theater_traning09_dialogue04_0020:
When an enemy shows yellow warning signs,
read each attack and dodge them in order.
theater_traning10_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers field effects
that occur in the Dungeon.
theater_traning10_dialogue02_0010: Field effects have appeared in the Dungeon.
theater_traning10_dialogue02_0020:
Stepping on a field effect grants various
buffs or status ailments to both
enemies and allies.
theater_traning10_dialogue02_0030:
Use field effects to gain the upper hand
in battle.
theater_traning11_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the unbreakable
shields enemies can deploy.
theater_traning11_dialogue02_0010:
Some enemies can deploy shields that
look different from normal shields.
theater_traning11_dialogue02_0020:
These shields can't be broken, and standing
near one exposes you to a powerful attack.
theater_traning11_dialogue03_0010:
As long as you don't get close, you can
safely wait out an unbreakable shield.
theater_traning11_dialogue03_0020:
When an enemy deploys an unbreakable shield,
stay calm and move away from it.
theater_traning12_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the counter shields
enemies can deploy.
theater_traning12_dialogue02_0010:
Some enemies can deploy shields that
look different from normal shields.
theater_traning12_dialogue02_0020:
Unlike normal shields, these have low durability.
Breaking one triggers not only effects that
hurt the enemy, but ones that help it too.
theater_traning12_dialogue03_0010:
If you don't break a counter shield,
it's not much different from a normal attack.
theater_traning12_dialogue03_0020:
When an enemy deploys a counter shield,
stay calm and decide whether to go for the
reward or play it safe.
theater_battle_1108009_dialogue01_0010:
To win this battle, survive until
the time limit runs out.
theater_battle_1108009_dialogue01_0020:
Make full use of Defense and Support Roles
to withstand the Silverback's attacks.
theater_battle_1108010_dialogue01_0010:
To win this battle, reach the goal.
Break through the walls and escape
from the Goliath.
theater_trial0113_dialogue01_0010:
[White Rabbit Chasing a Dream] Bell is
an adventurer with a new buff: "Longing."
theater_trial0113_dialogue01_0020:
Stacking "Longing" raises his Status and
Special power. Gather lots of "Longing" and
aim for huge damage with his Special.
theater_trial0113_dialogue02_0010:
[White Rabbit Chasing a Dream] Bell's Skill 1
is low-cost and grants "Longing"
to his own unit.
theater_trial0113_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 consumes 1 "Longing" for more power.
When Awakened, it also grants him
increased damage dealt for 10 seconds.
theater_trial0113_dialogue03_0010:
[White Rabbit Chasing a Dream] Bell's Special
consumes all "Longing," greatly increasing its
power for each stack consumed.
theater_trial0113_dialogue03_0020:
Stack "Longing" with Skill 1, then spend it
with Skill 2 and his Special to fight
more effectively.
theater_trial000115_dialogue01_0010:
[Rabbit Waltz] Bell has extremely powerful
Skills and Special. Using his Special also
reduces the cost of his Skills.
theater_trial000115_dialogue01_0020:
In exchange, his Skills and Special cost a lot,
so knowing when to use his Special
is key to playing him.
theater_trial000115_dialogue02_0010:
[Rabbit Waltz] Bell's Special deals heavy
damage to enemies in a wide area, while
also reducing the cost of his Skills.
theater_trial000115_dialogue02_0020:
Awakening Skill 2 three times grants him
increased damage dealt, further boosting
Skill 1 and Special damage.
theater_trial000115_dialogue03_0010:
[Dreaming Blossom] Chigusa's Assist Skill
grants her unit a shield while raising
its [Strength] Status.
theater_trial000115_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill raises Skill damage dealt,
so she can protect [Rabbit Waltz] Bell
while boosting his damage.
theater_trial000115_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000116_dialogue01_0010:
[Golden Dream] Bell's Skill 2 and Special
get stronger against Burning enemies.
theater_trial000116_dialogue01_0020:
Set enemies Burning with Skill 1 or the like,
then hit them with other attacks to
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial000116_dialogue02_0010:
[Golden Dream] Bell's Special deals damage
while raising normal attack damage dealt
for all of his units.
theater_trial000116_dialogue02_0020:
Against Burning enemies, his Special's
crit rate also rises, letting you aim
for even more Special damage.
theater_trial000116_dialogue03_0010:
[Striking It Rich] Liliruca's Assist Skill
can set enemies Burning for a few seconds.
theater_trial000116_dialogue03_0020:
She shines brightest when paired
with [Golden Dream] Bell.
theater_trial000116_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000117_dialogue01_0010:
[Fledgling Hero] Bell has a new buff: "Etoile."
Consuming "Etoile" greatly increases
the power of his Skills.
theater_trial000117_dialogue01_0020:
Holding down Skill 2 also increases its power.
Watch for openings and aim for big damage.
theater_trial000117_dialogue02_0010:
[Fledgling Hero] Bell's Special deals damage
while granting him increased Skill cost gain
and multiple "Etoile" for a time.
theater_trial000117_dialogue02_0020:
Skills 1 and 2 each consume a set amount
of "Etoile," greatly increasing damage dealt
for each one consumed.
theater_trial000117_dialogue03_0010:
[Tempest Sword Princess] Ais's Assist Skill
shields her while damaging enemies in a
wide area and pulling them in.
theater_trial000117_dialogue03_0020:
Follow up with [Fledgling Hero] Bell's Special
or Skill 2 to gain the upper hand.
theater_trial000117_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000306_dialogue01_0010:
[Romantic Smith] Welf's Skills get stronger
when used against Burning enemies.
theater_trial000306_dialogue01_0020:
He shines brightest paired with Specials
or battle items that set wide areas
of enemies Burning.
theater_trial000306_dialogue02_0010:
[Romantic Smith] Welf's Skills 1 and 2
grant shields to all of his units.
theater_trial000306_dialogue02_0020:
Hitting a Burning enemy grants him
an additional shield.
theater_trial000306_dialogue03_0010:
[Romantic Smith] Welf's Special damages
enemies in a frontal area while granting
shields to all of his units.
theater_trial000306_dialogue03_0020:
It can also set a wide area of enemies
Burning.
theater_trial0405_dialogue01_0010:
[Floaty Sword Princess] Ais Wallenstein's
normal attacks are extremely powerful.
theater_trial0405_dialogue01_0020:
Her Skill 2 raises normal attack power even
further. Use it well to keep dealing
high damage!
theater_trial0405_dialogue02_0010:
[Floaty Sword Princess] Ais Wallenstein's
Special is a wide-area multi-hit attack.
theater_trial0405_dialogue02_0020:
Later hits grow stronger. Land the maximum
number of hits for huge damage!
theater_trial0405_dialogue03_0010:
[Mischief Venus] Loki's Assist Skill
can lower enemy movement speed.
theater_trial0405_dialogue03_0020:
Pin enemies down and make sure your
powerful Skills connect!
theater_trial0405_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial0408_dialogue01_0010:
[First-Snow Sword Princess] Ais Wallenstein
specializes in powering herself up
with her Special.
theater_trial0408_dialogue01_0020:
Combine her Special with strong normal
attacks and Skills to aim for big damage.
theater_trial0408_dialogue02_0010:
[First-Snow Sword Princess] Ais Wallenstein's
Special greatly increases the power of her
normal attacks and Skills.
theater_trial0408_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 raises her Strength Status further,
so pairing her Special with her Skills
brings out her full potential.
theater_trial0408_dialogue03_0010:
[To the Summit of Art] Finn Deimne deals
damage while raising Skill damage dealt
for his unit.
theater_trial0408_dialogue03_0020:
His Passive Skill raises fire damage dealt,
boosting [First-Snow Sword Princess]
Ais Wallenstein's damage even further.
theater_trial0408_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000412_dialogue01_0010:
[Furisode Sword Princess] Ais has a "Counter
Shield." When her Counter Shield is broken,
she gains buffs.
theater_trial000412_dialogue01_0020:
[Furisode Sword Princess] Ais's Special
can also Bind enemies.
theater_trial000412_dialogue02_0010:
[Furisode Sword Princess] Ais's Skill 1 grants
her a Counter Shield. When it breaks, she gains
increased Endurance Status.
theater_trial000412_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 and her Special consume increased
Endurance for more power. Skill 2 also has
higher crit rate against Bound enemies.
theater_trial000412_dialogue03_0010:
[First Showdown] Lefiya's Assist Skill damages
enemies while making them take
increased damage.
theater_trial000412_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill raises water damage dealt,
so she pairs especially well with
water Attack Role adventurers.
theater_trial000412_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000507_dialogue01_0010:
[Bunny Dealer] Mikoto grows stronger the more
HP she keeps. Her Skill 2 and Special gain
powerful extra effects at max HP.
theater_trial000507_dialogue01_0020: Her Skill 1 can also restore her own HP.
theater_trial000507_dialogue02_0010:
[Bunny Dealer] Mikoto's Special deals damage,
and at max HP it also raises crit rate
and reduces Skill cost.
theater_trial000507_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 grants her 1–10 random stacks of
increased Special damage dealt,
stacking up to 100.
theater_trial000507_dialogue03_0010:
[Holy Night Goddess] Hestia's Assist Skill
grants her unit increased Special damage
dealt and regeneration.
theater_trial000507_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill grants increased Special
damage dealt, plus increased crit damage
while HP is 80% or higher.
theater_trial000507_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial000802_dialogue01_0010:
[Black Cat] Chloe's Skills and Special
get stronger against Poisoned enemies.
theater_trial000802_dialogue01_0020:
Poison enemies with Skill 2 or the like,
then hit them with other attacks to
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial000802_dialogue02_0010:
[Black Cat] Chloe's Skills cost a lot,
but deal high damage in return.
theater_trial000802_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 1 deals even more damage to Poisoned
enemies, so combining it with Skill 2
lets you deal huge damage.
theater_trial000802_dialogue03_0010:
[Black Cat] Chloe's Special damages enemies
in a frontal area while raising her own
Skill damage dealt.
theater_trial000802_dialogue03_0020:
If the enemy is Poisoned, it also reduces her
Skill cost, letting her use Skills more often.
theater_trial000902_dialogue01_0010:
[Black Fist] Lunoire is an adventurer whose
Skills and Special have low costs.
theater_trial000902_dialogue01_0020:
Her Skills are cheap but deal modest damage.
However, buffing herself with Skill 1
raises her firepower.
theater_trial000902_dialogue02_0010:
[Black Fist] Lunoire's Skill 1 has a chance to
grant her increased [Strength] or [Magic],
or increased Skill or Special damage dealt.
theater_trial000902_dialogue02_0020:
Each buff stacks up to 2 times, so keeping
track of which buffs you have helps you
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial000902_dialogue03_0010:
[Black Fist] Lunoire can stock Skills 1 and 2
up to 2 times each, and the Ability Board
can raise that number further.
theater_trial001003_dialogue01_0010:
[Chariot's Other Half] Anya resists status
ailments when using Skills. Using a Skill makes
her immune to status ailments for a moment.
theater_trial001003_dialogue01_0020:
Time your Skills with enemy attacks to keep
attacking even while being hit with
status ailments.
theater_trial001003_dialogue02_0010:
[Chariot's Other Half] Anya's Special damages
enemies in a frontal area while raising
her movement speed.
theater_trial001003_dialogue03_0010:
Awakening [Chariot's Other Half] Anya once adds
a shield to her Special, making it easier
to fight while taking hits.
theater_trial001004_dialogue01_0010:
[Vacation Cat] Anya powers herself up with
her Special. Using it greatly raises
her movement speed.
theater_trial001004_dialogue01_0020:
It also reduces Skill cost and grants
increased Skill damage dealt, so pairing
her Special with Skills deals big damage.
theater_trial001004_dialogue02_0010:
[Vacation Cat] Anya's Skills 1 and 2 grant
increased crit rate and increased crit
damage, respectively.
theater_trial001004_dialogue02_0020:
Both effects stack up to 6 times, so using
them back to back helps you gain
the upper hand.
theater_trial001004_dialogue03_0010:
Awakening [Vacation Cat] Anya increases her
Skill uses and adds effects like increased
fire damage dealt to her Special.
theater_trial1205_dialogue01_0010:
[Black Cat Witch] Ryu Lion's Skills get
stronger when used against Poisoned enemies.
theater_trial1205_dialogue01_0020:
She shines brightest paired with Specials
or battle items that Poison wide areas
of enemies.
theater_trial1205_dialogue02_0010:
[Black Cat Witch] Ryu Lion's Skills 1 and 2
recover Skill CT when they hit
"Poisoned" enemies.
theater_trial1205_dialogue02_0020:
[Pumpkin Witch] Syr Flover can raise crit rate,
so pairing the two lets you aim for
even higher damage.
theater_trial1205_dialogue03_0010:
[Black Cat Witch] Ryu Lion's Special
can Poison enemies in a wide area.
theater_trial1205_dialogue03_0020:
When Awakened, it also lowers enemy
Endurance. Weaken enemies with her Special
to gain the upper hand.
theater_trial1205_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial001207_dialogue01_0010:
[Gale Maiden] Ryu's normal attacks and Special
get stronger against Slowed enemies.
theater_trial001207_dialogue01_0020:
Her normal attacks always deal more damage
to Slowed enemies, so she shines brightest
paired with Skills that slow enemies.
theater_trial001207_dialogue02_0010:
[Gale Maiden] Ryu's Special, when it hits
a Slowed enemy, raises damage dealt
for her unit for a time.
theater_trial001207_dialogue02_0020:
Her Skill 2 also damages enemies in a
wide area while slowing them.
theater_trial001207_dialogue03_0010:
[Pure-Hearted Boy] Bell's Assist Skill
can Slow enemies for a few seconds.
theater_trial001207_dialogue03_0020:
Paired with [Gale Maiden] Ryu, he reliably
boosts her normal attack damage.
theater_trial001207_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial001208_dialogue01_0010:
[Eyes on Me Only!] Ryu's Special gets
stronger against Slowed enemies.
theater_trial001208_dialogue01_0020:
Slow enemies with Skill 2 or the like, then
hit them with her Special to gain
the upper hand.
theater_trial001208_dialogue02_0010:
[Eyes on Me Only!] Ryu's Skill 2 deals heavy
damage while greatly raising Special damage
dealt for her unit.
theater_trial001208_dialogue02_0020:
In exchange it costs a lot, so it works best
combined with Skill 1, which reduces
Skill cost.
theater_trial001208_dialogue03_0010:
[Bridal Sword Princess] Ais's Assist Skill
damages enemies while making them take
increased damage.
theater_trial001208_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill raises wind damage dealt and
crit rate, so she pairs especially well with
wind Attack and Speed Role adventurers.
theater_trial001208_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial001209_dialogue01_0010:
[Swimsuit Detective] Ryu's Special grants all
of her units increased fire damage dealt
and movement speed.
theater_trial001209_dialogue01_0020:
Fully Awakened, she also gains a big boost
to Skill damage dealt after using
her Special.
theater_trial001209_dialogue02_0010:
[Swimsuit Detective] Ryu's Skill 1 grants
all of her units a permanent
Magic Status increase.
theater_trial001209_dialogue02_0020:
Her Skill 2 pulls enemies in while healing
all of her units and raising their
Magic Status.
theater_trial001209_dialogue03_0010:
[Seaside Little Devil] Syr's Assist Skill
grants all of her units increased Skill
damage dealt and regeneration.
theater_trial001209_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill also makes enemies she hits
take increased damage, greatly boosting
your allies' damage.
theater_trial001209_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial001210_dialogue01_0010:
[Heir to Justice] Ryu has a new buff: "Answer
of Justice." Using her Special grants it and
changes how her Skills work.
theater_trial001210_dialogue01_0020:
While she has "Answer of Justice,"
[Heir to Justice] Ryu's Skills gain power
and extra effects.
theater_trial001210_dialogue02_0010:
[Heir to Justice] Ryu's Skill 1 damages enemies
while charging and grants increased shield
potency, boosting the shield after the charge.
theater_trial001210_dialogue02_0020:
With "Answer of Justice," it also grants
increased damage dealt while charging, and the
final hit makes enemies take more damage.
theater_trial001210_dialogue03_0010:
[Heir to Justice] Ryu's Skill 2
damages enemies while shielding her.
theater_trial001210_dialogue03_0020:
With "Answer of Justice," it deals more damage
to Burning enemies. Pair it with the Burn
from her Special for full effect.
theater_trial1303_dialogue01_0010:
[Sunbloom Elf] Lefiya Viridis has
a Special that pulls enemies in.
theater_trial1303_dialogue01_0020:
She shines brightest paired with her
Skill 1, which lowers enemy [Endurance],
or with other adventurers.
theater_trial1303_dialogue02_0010:
[Sunbloom Elf] Lefiya Viridis's Skill 2 heals
the party while raising their
Endurance Status.
theater_trial1303_dialogue02_0020:
[Cool Summer Elf] Riveria Ljos Alf's Assist
Skill raises healing, letting her
heal even more.
theater_trial1303_dialogue03_0010:
[Sunbloom Elf] Lefiya Viridis's Special
pulls enemies in a wide area toward her.
theater_trial1303_dialogue03_0020:
When Awakened, it also raises thunder damage
dealt for all units. Bunch enemies up and
hit lots of them at once!
theater_trial1303_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial1304_dialogue01_0010:
[Elf Chasing Her Dream] Lefiya is an
adventurer with a new buff: "Longing."
theater_trial1304_dialogue01_0020:
Her Special sets a field effect that heals
and grants buffs. In Co-op Showdowns and the
like, it also affects other players.
theater_trial1304_dialogue02_0010:
[Elf Chasing Her Dream] Lefiya's Skill 1
damages enemies while healing all
of her units.
theater_trial1304_dialogue02_0020:
Her Skill 2 damages enemies while raising
Magic Status for all of her units.
theater_trial1304_dialogue03_0010:
[Elf Chasing Her Dream] Lefiya's Special deals
damage, then sets a field effect that grants
allies a variety of buffs.
theater_trial1304_dialogue03_0020:
Use her in Co-op Showdowns or with [White
Rabbit Chasing a Dream] Bell to gain
the upper hand.
theater_trial001403_dialogue01_0010:
[Overflowing Feelings] Tione's Special gets
stronger against Slowed enemies.
theater_trial001403_dialogue01_0020:
Slow enemies with Skill 2 or the like, then
hit them with her Special to gain
the upper hand.
theater_trial001403_dialogue02_0010:
[Overflowing Feelings] Tione's Skill 1 damages
enemies while raising movement speed and
crit rate for all of her units.
theater_trial001403_dialogue02_0020:
Her Skill 2 damages enemies while
Slowing them.
theater_trial001403_dialogue03_0010:
[Overflowing Feelings] Tione's Special damages
enemies and sets a field effect that
reduces allies' Skill cost.
theater_trial001403_dialogue03_0020:
She shines brightest paired with high-cost
adventurers like [Eyes on Me Only!]
Ryu Lion.
theater_trial001503_dialogue01_0010:
[Sunny Smile] Tiona Hyrute grants her unit
damage-boosting buffs by attacking
enemies with Skills.
theater_trial001503_dialogue01_0020:
"Sunny Smile," granted by her Special, powers
up her Skills, and hitting enemies with Skills
grants additional buffs.
theater_trial001503_dialogue02_0010:
[Sunny Smile] Tiona Hyrute's Skills consume
the [Magic] increase from her Special to grant
increased Skill damage dealt.
theater_trial001503_dialogue02_0020:
Her Special consumes the [Strength] increase
from her Skills, granting increased Special
damage dealt per stack consumed.
theater_trial001503_dialogue03_0010:
[Lovely Blue] Ais Wallenstein's Assist Skill
grants Status-increasing buffs
that raise damage.
theater_trial001503_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill raises earth and Skill
damage dealt, and grants extra buffs
to female adventurers.
theater_trial001503_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with female characters.
theater_trial1801_dialogue01_0020:
Her Special lowers enemy Endurance, and
her two Skills have a chance to inflict
multiple status ailments.
theater_trial1801_dialogue02_0010:
[Perseus] Asfi's Special lowers enemy
Endurance, with a chance to lower their earth
damage dealt and raise damage taken.
theater_trial1801_dialogue02_0020:
Skills 1 and 2 also have a chance to inflict
multiple status ailments, potentially
weakening enemies greatly.
theater_trial1801_dialogue03_0010:
[Elf Maid] Ryu's Assist Skill lowers enemy
Strength while reducing their
movement speed.
theater_trial1801_dialogue03_0020:
That makes [Perseus] Asfi's attacks easier
to land, helping you gain the upper hand.
theater_trial1801_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial1901_dialogue01_0010:
[Warlord] Ottar is a Defense adventurer
who excels at knocking enemies back.
theater_trial1901_dialogue01_0020:
His normal attacks are slow but powerful,
with big knockback on the 4th hit. Skill 2
and his Special buff him and send foes flying.
theater_trial1901_dialogue02_0010:
[Warlord] Ottar's Special sends enemies flying,
while powering him up and reducing
his Skill cost.
theater_trial1901_dialogue02_0020:
Ottar's Skills cost a lot but perform well,
so using his Special wisely lets him
fight efficiently.
theater_trial1901_dialogue03_0010:
[Goddess of Beauty] Freya's Assist Skill heals
while lowering enemy earth damage dealt.
theater_trial1901_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill also raises durability,
further boosting [Warlord] Ottar's
survivability.
theater_trial1901_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial001903_dialogue01_0010:
[Proof of the Strongest] Ottar permanently
raises his unit's damage dealt by attacking
enemies with normal attacks and Skills.
theater_trial001903_dialogue01_0020:
Using his Special also greatly raises his
unit's Status and crit rate.
theater_trial001903_dialogue02_0010:
[Proof of the Strongest] Ottar's Skill 1
damages enemies while pulling them in and
lowering their Endurance.
theater_trial001903_dialogue02_0020:
Lowered Endurance and increased damage dealt
boost his damage, helping you
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial001903_dialogue03_0010:
[Proof of the Strongest] Ottar's Special deals
heavy damage while greatly raising his unit's
Strength and Magic.
theater_trial001903_dialogue03_0020:
It raises crit rate too, so combined with
increased damage dealt, his Skills can
deal even bigger damage.
theater_trial2104_dialogue01_0010:
[Mummy Girl] Cassandra Ilion's Skills and
Special get stronger against
Poisoned enemies.
theater_trial2104_dialogue01_0020:
Skill 1 and her Special deal more damage to
Poisoned enemies, so combine them with
Skill 2's Poison for big damage!
theater_trial2104_dialogue02_0010:
[Mummy Girl] Cassandra Ilion's Special
is a two-hit attack.
theater_trial2104_dialogue02_0020:
Use it on enemies Poisoned by Skill 2 for
huge damage. Land both hits to get
the most out of it.
theater_trial2104_dialogue03_0010:
[Pale Beauty of the Night] Daphne Lauros's
Assist Skill can Poison enemies
for a few seconds.
theater_trial2104_dialogue03_0020:
Paired with [Mummy Girl] Cassandra Ilion,
she lets you reliably aim for big damage.
theater_trial2104_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial002301_dialogue01_0010:
[Maenad] Filvis's Special grants herself and
all allied units shields and increased
Endurance.
theater_trial002301_dialogue01_0020:
Her Skills grant damage-boosting buffs, so
paired with her Special, she can protect allies
while still dealing damage.
theater_trial002301_dialogue02_0010:
[Maenad] Filvis's Skill 1 shields her while
granting all of her units a Magic increase
that stacks up to 5 times.
theater_trial002301_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 knocks enemies back and consumes all
her Magic increases to deal
high damage.
theater_trial002301_dialogue03_0010:
[Maenad] Filvis's Special grants herself and
all allied units shields and increased
Endurance.
theater_trial002301_dialogue03_0020:
It also grants 5 of the same Magic increases
as Skill 1, so combining it with Skill 2
helps you gain the upper hand.
theater_trial002609_dialogue01_0010:
[Moonlit Fox Beauty] Haruhime is a Speed Role
adventurer skilled at support. Skill 1 raises
crit rate for all of her units.
theater_trial002609_dialogue01_0020:
Using her Special also raises Skill cost gain
for all of her units for a time.
theater_trial002609_dialogue02_0010:
Awakening [Moonlit Fox Beauty] Haruhime twice
lets her Skill 1 grant increased crit damage
dealt to all of her units.
theater_trial002609_dialogue02_0020:
Her Special speeds up Skill usage, so she
shines brightest paired with adventurers
who have strong Skills.
theater_trial002609_dialogue03_0010:
[Bouquet of Smiles] Hestia's Assist Skill raises
her unit's normal attack and earth
damage dealt.
theater_trial002609_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill also raises normal attack
damage dealt, boosting [Moonlit Fox Beauty]
Haruhime's damage.
theater_trial002609_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial2803_dialogue01_0010:
[Flower of the Holy Night] Riveria can
power up fire adventurers.
theater_trial2803_dialogue01_0020:
Her Special lowers enemy Endurance and raises
fire damage dealt for all of her units.
theater_trial2803_dialogue02_0010:
[Flower of the Holy Night] Riveria's Special
lowers enemy Endurance while raising fire
damage dealt for all of her units.
theater_trial2803_dialogue02_0020:
Awakening adds increased Skill damage dealt
for all of her units. She shines brightest
paired with fire Attack Roles.
theater_trial2803_dialogue03_0010:
[Hearty Holy Night] Gareth's Assist Skill deals
damage while raising his unit's
Magic Status.
theater_trial2803_dialogue03_0020:
He boosts the healing from [Flower of the
Holy Night] Riveria's Skill 2, helping you
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial2803_dialogue03_0030: Try fighting freely with these two together.
theater_trial003702_dialogue01_0010:
[Dea Saint] Amid's Special grants all of
her units protection that negates one
lethal hit for a time.
theater_trial003702_dialogue01_0020:
It also heals and grants increased water
damage dealt, so using her Special well
helps you gain the upper hand.
theater_trial003702_dialogue02_0010:
[Dea Saint] Amid's Skill 1 grants
"Regeneration," which heals at
regular intervals.
theater_trial003702_dialogue02_0020:
It also heals instantly, so together with
Regeneration it greatly restores HP
for all of her units.
theater_trial003702_dialogue03_0010:
[Dea Saint] Amid's Skill 2 knocks back nearby
enemies while raising Strength and Magic
for all of her units.
theater_trial003702_dialogue03_0020:
Used with Skill 1 and her Special, she can
protect herself while healing and buffing
all of her units.
theater_trial003901_dialogue01_0010:
[Vana Freya] Allen can continuously build
cost by using his Special.
theater_trial003901_dialogue01_0020:
Combine his Skills and Special to deal
heavy damage to enemies again and again.
theater_trial003901_dialogue02_0010:
[Vana Freya] Allen's Skill 1 deals damage
while raising his movement speed and water
damage dealt.
theater_trial003901_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 1 also builds Skill cost like a normal
attack. Skill 2 grants his unit status
ailment resistance.
theater_trial003901_dialogue03_0010:
[Vana Freya] Allen's Special deals damage while
continuously building Skill and Special cost
for all of his units.
theater_trial003901_dialogue03_0020:
It also consumes the movement speed increase
from Skill 1 to raise Special
damage dealt.
theater_trial004901_dialogue01_0010:
[Bringar] Alfrik's Special lowers enemy
Endurance while granting all of his units
shields and increased shield potency.
theater_trial004901_dialogue01_0020:
His Skill 1 can Stun enemies, so combining it
with other Skills and units helps you
gain the upper hand.
theater_trial004901_dialogue02_0010:
[Bringar] Alfrik's Skill 1 deals damage and
Stuns enemies, leaving them unable to act
for a time.
theater_trial004901_dialogue02_0020:
His new buff, "Increased Shield Potency,"
raises the shields he grants
while it lasts.
theater_trial004901_dialogue03_0010:
[Bringar] Alfrik's Skill 2 and Special grant
shields, so they work best combined with
increased shield potency.
theater_trial005402_dialogue01_0010:
[Diva of the Age] Harmonia has a new buff:
"Etoile." Her Special heals and sets a field
effect that grants buffs.
theater_trial005402_dialogue01_0020:
[Diva of the Age] Harmonia's Skill 1 damages
enemies while healing all of her units.
theater_trial005402_dialogue02_0010:
While charging, Skill 1 keeps healing and
granting increased Skill damage, so the longer
the charge, the more healing and damage.
theater_trial005402_dialogue02_0020:
[Diva of the Age] Harmonia's Skill 2 damages
enemies while Binding them and lowering
their Endurance.
